The remaining posts share only a general distrust tone: T4-009173 alleges "corruption in our justice system" [T4-009173](#T4-009173), and T4-003068 is a hostile reply accusing a named figure of "SPREADING LIES" [T4-003068](#T4-003068), while T4-003396 concerns prison labor and is unrelated [T4-003396](#T4-003396). None of the retrieved posts is a rebuttal or quotation of the new post, and shared topics do not indicate agreement or coordination.
